mechanism_narrative: The current FEDFUNDS rate of 1.55% (below the historical average of 2.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 260 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5pp and CPIAUCSL > 260), the central bank's hawkish stance compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp and CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST value below 1300 signals weak housing demand, indicating a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and fall in housing starts (HOUST) signals a housing market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 5% and HOUST falls > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS rises > 5% and HOUST falls > 1% in 3 months.
